message.content:
This editorial illustration features a stylized, dark teal male figure in profile, leaning over a light-colored wooden structure. The figure’s upper body and hands, rendered with dense dark hatching, are positioned over rectangular beams. From this horizontal framework, four thick, rounded columns of white, foamy-textured water flow vertically downward. The background consists of jagged red shapes flanking the central figure against a grainy yellow and teal gradient.

At the top, a large red "TEMPO" logo is centered. Above it, text reads "Uang Semir Label Halal H.30" and "Perang Beking Nikel Konawe H.72". A barcode and QR code are positioned at the top right above "28 MARET-3 APRIL 2022" and "RP 50.000". Large black text at the bottom right reads "JEJAK LUHUT DI PEMBANGKIT KAYAN". Below this is a smaller text block mentioning "Garibaldi Thohir di Kalimantan Utara," a "pembangkit listrik tenaga air Kayan," "Kawasan Industri Hijau Indonesia," and "Menteri Luhut Pandjaitan," ending with "H.82". The illustration uses a limited palette of teal, red, yellow, and white with a stippled texture throughout.
